title: Broncos GM George Paton says the Broncos are focused on 6 players at pick 62

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos GM George Paton says the Broncos are focused on 6 players at pick 62
sources.description: The Denver Broncos held their pre-draft press conference today, and we learned some interesting nuggets from the Broncos’ decision makers. General manager George Paton told reporters that the Broncos are focused on a total of six players who they believe will be there at pick 62. Sean Payton, George Paton, and the rest of the […]
